statuses.fixed_ledger: a single completed A_Z is dominated at every stage
statuses.exhaustive_ledger: partial ledgers promote to A_Z with vanishing tail
statuses.moving_ledger_support_only: stage ledgers move without a completed/tail record
statuses.failed_separation: anti-invariant readout does not separate the fixed locus
statuses.failed_promotion: finite zero windows do not promote to the completed zero ledger

acceptance_condition: fixed_ledger or exhaustive_ledger plus readout separation plus vanishing obstruction budget
